findings.title: No Authentication on Any API Endpoint
findings.remediation: Add JWT Bearer middleware globally before all app.use('/api/...') registrations. Create POST /api/auth/login. Install bcrypt.

findings.title: Full Pipeline Bypass via Force-Approve Chain
findings.remediation: Gate force-approve behind authentication AND approver role (RBAC). Re-validate item status server-side before accepting any transition.
findings.note: Depends on F-001 (auth) and F-008 (RBAC) being resolved first

findings.title: Soft-Delete Creates Permanent Dependency Deadlock
findings.remediation: On soft-delete, cascade-resolve or remove all dependency links pointing to the deleted item. Distinguish 'not found' from 'soft-deleted' in findById.

findings.title: Stored XSS via Unsanitized Description Field
findings.remediation: Server-side strip HTML from all free-text fields using sanitize-html. Audit frontend for dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Add CSP headers.

findings.title: Missing Webhook Signature Validation + Enum Field Injection
findings.remediation: Validate X-Zendesk-Webhook-Signature HMAC-SHA256 against ZENDESK_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var. Add enum guards for type/priority matching workItems.ts. Require bearer token for /automated.

findings.title: Reject Triggers Unintended Auto-Dispatch Cascade
findings.remediation: Gate cascade dispatch behind explicit confirmation flag. Add dry-run preview endpoint. Emit structured audit events for all cascaded dispatches.

findings.title: Approve Reachable from routing Transient Status
findings.remediation: Remove 'approved' as a valid target from 'routing' status in VALID_STATUS_TRANSITIONS. Add integration test: POST /approve on routing-status item must return 409.

findings.title: No Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
findings.remediation: Define roles (viewer, contributor, approver, dispatcher) in JWT claims. Add RBAC middleware per route. Derive ChangeHistoryEntry.agent from authenticated principal.

findings.title: No TLS / HTTPS Enforcement
findings.remediation: TLS-terminating reverse proxy for production. HTTP→HTTPS redirect middleware. HSTS header (max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains).

findings.title: Unauthenticated Prometheus /metrics Endpoint
findings.remediation: Restrict to internal network via reverse proxy IP allowlist, or add bearer-token check to /metrics route handler.

findings.title: No Pagination Upper-Bound (DoS Risk)
findings.remediation: const limit = Math.min(parseInt(req.query.limit) || 20, 100). Validate page is positive integer. Add express-rate-limit globally.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Security Headers / No CORS Policy
findings.remediation: npm install helmet cors. app.use(helmet()) and app.use(cors({ origin: ['https://prod-domain.com'] })) as first middleware.

findings.title: Required Audit Events Not Emitted
findings.remediation: Add auditLog(event_type, payload) helper with mandatory event_type field routed to append-only sink. Wire auth and permission middleware to emit login_attempt, permission_denied, data_export events.

findings.title: NeedsClarification Verdict Silently Collapses to Rejected
findings.remediation: Add explicit third branch for NeedsClarification → pending_clarification status with submitter notification and audit log entry.

findings.title: Repeated Assessment Calls Accumulate Unbounded Pod Records
findings.remediation: Enforce maximum one active assessment pod per item; replace rather than append on repeated calls.

findings.title: No GDPR Hard Delete / Right to Erasure
findings.remediation: Add hardDelete(id) to workItemStore.ts. Define data retention policy. Expose privileged DELETE /api/work-items/:id?hard=true endpoint.

findings.title: Internal Error Messages Returned to HTTP Clients
findings.remediation: Return generic 'Internal server error' from catch blocks. Log full error server-side with correlation ID.

findings.title: No MFA Support (Derivative of Auth Absence)
findings.remediation: Implement auth (F-001) first. Then add TOTP/WebAuthn step-up for approver and dispatcher roles.

findings.title: Missing Enum Validation in Intake Routes
findings.remediation: Add Object.values(WorkItemType).includes(body.type) guards in intake handlers (see also F-005).

findings.title: Sequential ID Enumeration
findings.remediation: Use UUID v4 for all item IDs. Auth (F-001) also mitigates direct enumeration.

findings.title: iframe Missing sandbox Attribute in Debug Portal
findings.remediation: Add sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms" to iframe element.

findings.title: Container Runs as Root (No USER Directive)
findings.remediation: RUN useradd -r -u 1001 appuser && chown -R appuser /app. Add USER appuser before CMD.

findings.title: No Encryption Framework for Sensitive Fields
findings.remediation: Add AES-256-GCM field-level encryption wrapper before any sensitive field (email, password, token, secret, api_key) is introduced.
